assertions.name: Bring 1/√5 residual-mixing predicts S and Se within 0.15°

description: H₂S +2.1° (and the group-16 trend) as residual s-mixing with the Bring 1/√5 coefficient. Third-row pure-p atoms retain residual s-character f_s = (1/√5)/(n−1)², so θ = 90° + (1/√5)·(arccos(−1/3)−90°)/(n−1)² — no fit. Predicts S 92.18° (obs 92.1°), Se 90.97° (obs 91.0°) within 0.1°; Te 90.54° (floor). The coefficient is the Bring/quintic constant 1/√5 (the S³-embedding chiral curvature surfacing as √5), the size dependence inverse-square (s–p gap²). Tiered: strong near-match, Bring-grounded, but only 2 constraining points.
